# Boombaland

> Boombaland is a classic bomb-maze arcade game for iPhone, iPad and Android phones and tablets, made by DataSight,
> the one-person studio of Tom de Bruijn in the Netherlands. Status: Out now on the App Store and Google Play.

- You drop bombs, run from the blasts, break crates, grab power-ups and outsmart enemies on grid boards, with bosses
  and push-block puzzles.
- 25 levels in Green Lands and on Castle Road; six heroes (Blom, Gusto, Frosta, Zappy, Ember and Banshee), each with
  their own skill; four difficulties from Easy to Impossible. Single player, against computer-controlled enemies.
- Bosses and special enemies: Grimdorn, Arko, Nimbo, Turto and Gardo.
- Free to play, with optional in-app purchases. Ads only play when you choose to watch one for a reward. No loot boxes:
  every chest shows the item it guarantees and the chance of everything else.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6821619320
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.datasight.boomworld
